journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Digital tools as a means of building media-educational communication among participants in the educational process
abstract: Background.The digital transformation of education, as a natural stage of socio-technological development of society, leads to a radical paradigm shift in pedagogical interaction. This highlights the need for scientific inquiry aimed at identifying thespecific role of digital tools in organizing effective communication among all participants in the educational process. Purpose.The purpose of the study is to identify and provide theoretical foundation for the functional role of digital tools in establishing, maintaining, and developing connections among participants in the educational process through the construction of an integrated system of media-educational communication. Materials and methods.The study employed a set of methods: theoretical analysis of scientific literature; synthesis, which allowed formulating the author’s definition of a key concept; student surveys to collect empirical data; content analysis of respondents’ answers; systematization and classification of digital tools according to the proposed functional-communicative criterion. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Project work of students majoring in metallurgy in a modern format
abstract: Background.The article is devoted to the problem of organizing project work of students majoring in the field of metallurgy. Project work is considered to be a tool for the formation of students’ professional competencies. The ability to bring up a problem and identify an information gap, formulate the project task based on the problem, and develop a strategy for solving the problem, as well as a plan for implementing the given strategy, the ability to work in teams are valid criteria which serve as indicators of the quality of training of future metallurgists in the system of higher education. The introduction of project assignments in new formats into the traditional form of university education, in which students learn to solve the real problems of industrial production, is relevant in today’s conditions and makes the research relevant. Thepurposeof the study is to identify and put into practice pedagogical conditions which will be conducive to the metallurgical students’ project work and which will make it more effective . journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Features of the behavioral component of the self-concept of a bilingual personality
abstract: Background. Bilingualism is a widespread phenomenon in the modern globalized world, yet its impact on personality structure and interpersonal behavior remains insufficiently studied. While extensive research has examined cognitive consequences of bilingualism, the behavioral component of self-concept of bilingual individuals, particularly across different levels of language proficiency, requires further investigation. The purpose of this study is to investigate the behavioral component of the self-concept of a bilingual personality with different levels of proficiency in the second language. Materials and methods. The study involved 390 participants divided into three equal groups: monolinguals, receptive bilinguals (passive understanding of the second language), and productive bilinguals (active fluent command of two languages). The Leary Interpersonal Diagnostic System was used across eight behavioral octants. To identify significant differences between bilingual and monolingual groups the Mann-Whitney U-test was used. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Consequences of the integration of combat psychological trauma into the dynamic sense system
abstract: Background.In the context of modern geopolitical realities, the issues of psychological rehabilitation of persons who participated in hostilities are of particular importance. The high prevalence of combat trauma among the participants of the SWO, as well asthe lack of knowledge of the mechanisms of reproduction of traumatic experiences in everyday life, make this issue scientifically and socially significant. Repeated traumatic experiences indicate deep violations in the system of sense formation of the personality. Understanding these mechanisms is necessary to develop effective rehabilitation strategies, prevent social adaptation of veterans, and reduce the risk of deviant behavior and suicidal tendencies. Purpose– to describe the integration of combat trauma into a dynamic sense system (DSS) and to study the consequences of this process, in particular the recurring painful experiences of the combat trauma of veteran. Materials and methods.The main research method is a systematic approach. Based on this approach, a theoretical modeling of the structure of the DSS of a combatant suffering from the consequences of the combat trauma is carried out. The article is based on a complex

journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Students’ cognitive activity style attention deficit disorder
abstract: Background.The success of learning activities directly depends on the student’s ability to effectively concentrate, switch between tasks and distribute attention between different types of activities. The prevalence of attention disorders among students has increased significantly in recent years. Modern students face a lot of distractions such as social media, gadgets, and multimedia devices, making it difficult to maintain a steady level of concentration. Studying the features of cognitive styles allows us to develop techniques and strategies aimed at improving the effectiveness of the educational process. Purposeis to study the cognitive activity style of students with attention deficit. Materials and methods. The study sample consisted of 65 students aged 18 to 25 years. The distribution of subjects by gender was 18 men and 47 women. The research method is testing. Psychodiagnostic techniques: A comparison test of similar drawings by J. Kagan, the Toulouse-Pieron Test. The method of mathematical statistics used in the analysis of the obtained data is Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Organization of the educational process in special educational institutions of the Bashkir ASSR in the 1970-1980 years
abstract: Background.In today's social development, the organization of special educational support for children with disabilities is particularly important. The education and development of children with physical, physiological, and mental disabilities can be considered one of the most pressing socio-pedagogical challenges in modern education. This is due to the increasing number of such children and the expanding diversity of disability categories. The current special education system faces numerous theoretical, methodological, and practical challenges. Children in specialized institutions are isolated from society, which predetermines them for unsuccessful socialization and the impossibility of personal growth. However, our country already had a fairly productive period in the history of public education and upbringing of children with special educational needs—the Soviet period. Without overestimating the experience accumulated by the educational system in those days, it is logical to assume that it could be quite useful for today. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Problems in achieving objectivity in creative writing assessment: students’ perceptions
abstract: Background.The issue of objective assessment of students’ creative written assignments in advanced foreign language instruction remains relevant in the context of the competence-based approach and the growing emphasis on the verification and transparency of learning outcomes in higher education. Along with comprehensive consideration of linguistic, discourse-related and pragmatic parameters, various objective and subjective factors that affect assessment may arouse scientific interest. Purpose.The aim of the study is to identify students’ perceptions about the transparency of assessment procedures and factors affecting objectivity of assessing written tasks, followed by a comparison of these perceptions with the previously described views of teachers. Materials and methods.The main methodology includes the systemic and comparative approaches that allow to view assessment as a multifactorial process and to analyse discrepancies in the positions of different participants in the education process. The main research methods are a questionnaire-based survey and qualitative data analysis. Results.The findings indicate that both students and teachers acknowledge the importance of formal a

journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Digital transformation in technical education: challenges of generative artificial intelligence for pedagogical practices
abstract: Background.The digital transformation of higher technical education, accelerated by the introduction of generative artificial intelligence (AI), generates a state of methodological instability when technological practices outpace the regulatory and ethical framework of the academic environment. There is a crisis of academic identity: students massively use AI tools, but do not legitimize them in ethical discourse, which transforms the very concept of “knowledge” from the product of cognitive labor to the result of algorithmic curatorial activity. This problem is particularly acute in the technical disciplines of energy, information technology, and machine learning, where the boundary between instrumental support and delegation of professional competencies is becoming blurred. Purpose.The aim is to identify the mechanisms of digital transformation in technical education, to analyze the normative gap between the practice of using generative AI and ethical assessments of students, as well as to identify strategies for pedagogical adaptation to the conditions of algorithmically mediated learning in engineering specialties. Materials and methods. The study is based on data from represen

journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Actors of upbringing in the dynamics of generations: theoretical and empirical analysis of contemporary trends
abstract: Background.The article examines issues related to identifying and understanding the educational potential and capacities of various actors involved in the upbringing of children and youth in contemporary Russia. Within an interdisciplinary framework, it explores the theoretical and methodological foundations of the stated problem and presents the results of an empirical study that offers a comparative analysis of educational actors significant for children and young people in the last quarter of the 20th century and the first quarter of the 21st century. Purpose. To conduct a comparative analysis of the phenomenon of educational actors significant for children and youth in the last quarter of the 20th century and the first quarter of the 21st century. Materials and methods.The article employs analytical and empirical methods that allow for a comprehensive interpretation of the available theoretical and empirical data on the issue under study. Results.Based on empirical data, the authors reconstruct and compare two systems of upbringing during key periods in the history of Russian society through a comparative analysis of the complex system of institutions and specific educational a

journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Teacher’s methodological competence as the foundation of primary school students’ orthographic literacy
abstract: Background.The article emphasizes the relevance of shifting from merely stating the problem of low literacy among schoolchildren to addressing its underlying cause – the deficit in teachers’ predictive and reflective skills. It is argued that the high percentage of errors among students is not due to a lack of teaching materials, but rather to a deficit in specific methodological skills of the teacher. Thepurposeof the work is to theoretically substantiate and empirically identify the structure of a teacher’s methodological competence as a key condition for overcoming spelling difficulties. Methodology.The research is based on methods including the study of regulatory documents, analysis and synthesis of psychological-pedagogical and methodological literature, a questionnaire survey and processing of its results, and the analysis of school textbooks. Results.Based on the analysis of psychological and pedagogical literature, the content of the concept “teacher’s methodological competence” in the field of spelling has been refined, and its cognitive, operational-technological, predictive, and reflective components have been identified. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Educational events in the context of developing subjective potential of pre-service teachers through simulating future professional activities
abstract: Background.Current challenges necessitate a profound transformation of the education system, affecting its substantive, methodological and organizational foundations, the key vector of which is the targeted development of the ability to pre-adapt, i.e., advanced readiness for meaningful and reflective activity in a dynamically developing professional environment. Purpose.To provide a theoretical and methodological substantiation of a model for the design and implementation of a simulation-based educational event. The model is contextualized within pilot educational programmes for pre-service teachers which is aimed at developing the agency of students. Materials and methods.The methodological basis of the study is a set of methods that integrates theoretical analysis of national and foreign scientific publications within the framework of the research issue, analysis of international and national regulatory documents governing educational policy and a summary of best practices in integrating simulation technologies and the potential of the educational event into pre-service teacher professional training system. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Systemic model for ensuring a safe educational environment in educational organizations
abstract: Background.Children are one of the most vulnerable groups in society. It is crucial to prevent the spread of juvenile delinquency at an early stage and prevent the spread of violence and cruelty in families, schools, and orphanages. The emergence of crime in educational institutions, the environment designed to ensure the safety, development, and socialization of the younger generation is of great concern. Purpose. Analysis of models and principles for implementing a safe educational environment in modern Russia. Materials and methods. The primary research methods were analytical, generalizing, and content analysis of scientific approaches to organizing a safe educational environment. Systems approach was employed, allowing educational institution safety examination as a multi-layered structure encompassing regulatory, psychological, pedagogical, social, and health-promoting components. Empirical data was drawn from case studies involving deviant behavior and violence in educational institutions from 2024 to 2026, as well as discussions of professional case studies with educational institution employees. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Psychological support and personality traits of children of military personnel participating in the special military operation
abstract: Background.This article examines the characteristics of the psycho-emotional state and personality of schoolchildren from families of military personnel participating in aspecial military operation. The article presents the results of an empirical study aimed at identifying the impact of psychological and pedagogical support on students’ emotional, behavioral, and academic spheres. It was found that a family member’s participation in a special military operation negatively affects students’ academic performance, anxiety levels, and propensity for deviant behavior. The implementation of a psychological and pedagogical support program contributed to a reduction in anxiety, stabilization of emotional state, improved social adaptation, and increased academic motivation. The study concludes that psychological and pedagogical support is effective when working with children from families of special military operation participants. Thepurposeis to investigate the impact of psychological support on the personality traits of students from families of participants in the Special Military Operation. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Modern scientific and pedagogical approaches to the formation of patriotism in college students based on educational programs of secondary general education
abstract: Background.This work highlights the issues of strengthening patriotic education in the system of secondary vocational education. The article presents an analysis of criteria and indicators that make it possible to determine the level of development of patriotism among students. In addition, the study reveals the theoretical foundations and key principles of fostering patriotic feelings among young people receiving vocational education, as well as identifies the current difficulties encountered in integrating the patriotic component into the educational activities of educational institutions. In an era of increasing attention to national traditions and civic consciousness, this research is gaining special value. Cultural heritage, with its diversity and uniqueness, can not only inspire, but also significantly influence the development of the creative potential of society. Understanding this relationship is becoming critically important in the context of a resurgent respect for the country’s historical heritage, which contributes to the formation of distinctive features of society. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Intellectual activity of artists under conditions of introversion-extroversion and overall creativity
abstract: Background.Introversion-extraversion as a personality factor can serve as predictors of creative achievement across various professional groups. Creative ability is defined by creative thinking. For artists, key aspects of creative thinking include fluency, originality, abstractness, and resistance to closure. Manifestations of creative thinking include intellectual activity, which functions as a motivational marker of creativity. The levels of intellectual activity among artists are associated with different levels of introversion–extraversion in the context of varying levels of creative thinking. Purpose.The aim is to identify the relationship between introversion-extroversion, overall creativity, and intellectual activity among artists. Materials and methods.The sample included 110 artists aged from 14 to 81 years (65% women). They were tested for introversion-extroversion (I-E) using the Eysenck-Wilson method, evaluated for creative thinking with Torrance’s Creative Thinking Tests, and their level of intellectual activity (LIA) was measured using Turyan’s method (Creativity Cards). journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Psychological features of the relationship of irrational beliefs with the traits of the dark and light personality triads in students
abstract: Background. The urgency of the problem is due to the importance of identifying integrated personality characteristics that describe typical human behaviors, as well as factors that determine their manifestation and functioning. Such characteristics include traits of the Dark (Machiavellianism, narcissism, psychopathy) and Light (faith in humanity, humanism, Kantianism) personality triads. Purpose. Identification of psychological features of the interrelation of irrational beliefs with the features of the Dark and Light personality triads among students. Materials and methods. The empirical study involved 174 students and undergraduates from Moscow City Pedagogical University and Cherepovets State University in various fields of study, with an average age of 21 (SD=4.1), 84 men (48.28%). The questionnaire (list) of irrational beliefs by A. Beck and A. Freeman, the Short Questionnaire of the Dark Triad by D. N. Jones and D. L. Paulhus adapted by M. S. Egorova, M. A. Sitnikova, O.V. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Task-based approach in the pedagogical practice of future foreign language
abstract: Background. The relevance of the problem and the research topic at the socio-pedagogical level is determined by the discrepancies between the new understanding of the social mission of education in a world where the key role is assigned to the personality of the teacher-educator, mentor, and researcher, and the actual potential of the majority of teachers. The outflow of the most capable teachers from schools to other sectors is particularly pronounced in the language education system. However, the unsatisfactory number of young recruits, where only a third of graduates from foreign language faculties and institutes begin working in their profession, represents just one aspect of the teaching staff issue, which necessitates the involvement of material incentives for resolution. The purpose of this study is to analyze this problem within the broader context of the notions of the personal orientation and the sources of professional development. The research also seeks to develop, methodologically justify, and test a system of the tasks for the pedagogical practice, structured around a task-based approach to foster the professional orientation of the future foreign language teachers.

journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: A component-based approach to the formation of positive civil identity of student youth
abstract: Background.One of the tasks of educational work of universities is the formation of a harmonious, socially responsible personality with positive citizenship. Thepurposeof our research is to substantiate a component-based approach to the formation of positive civic identity of students in the educational process. Materials and methods.The study was based on V.N. Myasishchev’s theory of relations, which views the individual as a system of relationships with the world, oneself, and other people. Civil identity is considered as the awareness of belonging to the community of citizens of a state, which has a personal meaning. The empirical base was based on a survey of university students in St. Petersburg in April 2025 (n=500). As units of analysis, based on the theory of relations V.N. Myasishchev, the components of the structure of the relationship were chosen – cognitive (knowledge), emotional (feelings) and behavioral (actions). Sentiment analysis and statistical distribution analysis were chosen as data processing methods. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Conceptual abilities of senior schoolchildren as a resource of intellectual productivity and the basis for the formation of personal cognitive style
abstract: Background.In the context of global intellectual competition and the transformation of the cognitive sphere of modern adolescents (a shift from conceptual-logical thinking to formal-imaginative generalizations), the study of conceptual abilities as a basic mechanism for organizing mental experience becomes particularly relevant. Drawing on L.M. Vekker’s ideas about the polymodal nature of thinking, M.A. Kholodnaya’s concept of conceptual abilities, and V.A. Tolochek’s resource approach, we consider conceptual abilities (semantic, categorical, conceptual) as an intrasubjective resource that ensures the integration of different levels of stylistic behavior and the qualitative transformation of functional systems of intellectual activity. Purpose.To determine the relationship between indicators of conceptual abilities (conceptual, categorical, semantic) and the success of intellectual activity (academic performance) in older adolescents and to interpret these relationships in the context of the formation of personal cognitive style. Materials and methods.The study involved 110 9th-grade students (61 girls, 49 boys) from secondary schools in Khimki, aged 15–16 years (median – 15 years)

journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Modern models of tutoring in higher educational institutions of the Russian Federation
abstract: Background.System of tutoring in higher educational institutions if the Russian Federation is becoming more relevant every year. This fact is confirmed by normative legal acts aimed at legislative establishment of system of tutoring in universities. However, the system if tutoring in Russian universities requires improvement of its mechanisms including analysis and elaboration of optimal models of tutoring. Purpose. Analysis of models of tutoring existing in Russian universities, collection of research confirming the efficiency of tutoring in universities, revelation of relations between the functioning of the tutoring model in universities and the high academic and personal outcomes of university graduates. Materials and methods. The main method of studying of models of tutoring is the elementary theoretical analysis. The method of direct synthesis was used in studying of efficiency of tutoring models. The article is based on a complex of sources presented by the normative legal acts, periodicals, methodical manuals and scientific monograph. Results. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Characteristics of adolescent identity formation in the context of school and family environments
abstract: Background.Modernization in today’s Russian society, driven by digitalization, social change, and evolving family values, has led to an “identity crisis” among teenagers, resulting in adaptation issues in school and at home. The authors demonstrate that teenage identity is shaped not just by developmental psychology but also by the school environment (teaching methods, peer groups) and family milieu (parenting styles, emotional support), along with supportive socio-psychological policies that foster collaboration between schools, families, and society in child-rearing. Purpose. An analysis of the structure and specifics of adolescent identity formation in the school and family environment based on empirical research. Materials and methods. The main research method employed was empirical, incorporating elements of both qualitative and quantitative analysis. Quantitative metrics (surveys, self-assessment scales) were used to describe the dynamics of changes in identity levels. The article is based on a comprehensive set of sources, including questionnaire data, observations of adolescent behavior, interviews with parents and teachers, as well as materials related to the implementatio

journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Assessing the level of physical fatigue for primary schoolchildren in everyday life
abstract: Background.General education institutions are considered an important venue for influencing children’s physical activity, given the amount of time spent in school and the schools’ potential to reach large numbers of children.Physical education, which develops psychological resilience and motivates young students to achieve, is a necessary component of this psychological and pedagogical process. Purpose.This article examines the assessment of physical fatigue in primary school children to subjectively assess their level of fatigue, energy, and cognitive function in everyday life.It aims to compare the level of physical fatigue in primary schoolchildren participating in various extracurricular sports with that of primary and secondary school children. Methodology.To achieve the study’s objective, we analyzed the level of physical fatigue in primary school children in their daily lives for the experimental group of children who participated in additional sports activities and the control group using the “Physical Fatigue of Primary School Children” questionnaire.Statistical comparison of the research results was performed using the Student’s t-test. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Clinical and psychological analysis of incomplete separation in the personality structure of a film character (Based on the film The Irony of Fate, or Enjoy Your Bath!)
abstract: Background.The phenomenon of infantilism and incomplete separation in socially adapted adults remains one of the least diagnosed yet widespread forms of personality organization. In mass culture, such states are not only represented but also acquire the status of socially approved scenarios, which complicates their psychological reflection. The cinema of E. Ryazanov, in particular the character of Evgeny Lukashin, provides unique material for the clinical and psychological reconstruction of this phenomenon in its culturally normative form. Purpose.To identify the symptom complex of incomplete separation-individuation in the personality structure of a film character and to interpret the narrative logic of the film as a model of refusal of psychological autonomy. Materials and methods.The material of the study is the film The Irony of Fate, or Enjoy Your Bath! (dir. E. Ryazanov, 1975). The methodological framework is an integrative approach combining M. Mahler’s theory of separation-individuation, D.W. Winnicott’s concept of the «false self,» the archetypal analysis of the puer aeternus (M.-L. von Franz), and methods of film psychology. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Criteria-based approach to the assessment of educational results of a specialist in the field of physical education: conceptual and content-based framework
abstract: Background.The increasing role of physical education for citizens of the Russian Federation and the reform of higher professional education necessitate new approaches to updating educational policy and training specialists in physical education. The author presents an idea and describes a conceptual framework for assessing the educational performance of physical education specialists during their studies at a higher education institution, based on a criteria-based approach. Purpose.The aim of the study was to provide a theoretical and conceptual justification for the use of a criteria-based approach to assessing the educational performance of physical education specialists. Materials and methods.The primary research method is an analysis of theories and methodological approaches to the training of specialists in physical education at higher education institutions. The article draws on a set of legal and regulatory documents governing the content of higher professional education and the physical education and sports system in the Russian Federation. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Model for forming health-saving competence among students of transport universities
abstract: Background.In recent decades, our country has seen a steady decline in health indicators, overall levels of physical activity, fitness, and interest in various health practices among students. The increasing cost of professional errors related to the «human factor» in railway transport highlights the need for professional and applied physical training for students at railway universities, a key outcome of which is health-saving competencies. Purpose. The research purpose is to develop a model for forming health-saving competence among students of transport universities. Materials and methods. The analysis of scientific research literature allowed us to clarify the substantive characteristics and structural components of the concepts of «health-saving competence» and «self-organization» and to identify their logical interdependence. Pedagogical modeling included the development of a model for developing health-saving competence, experimental work, mathematical processing of quantitative and qualitative indicators, and comparative analysis. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Analysis of the features of motivation to achieve success in the structure of meaningful life orientations: a case study of the youth of Donbass
abstract: Background.Student age is a sensitive period for the formation of an integral system of life-meaning orientations and stable patterns of achievement motivation, which determines the trajectory of personal and professional development. However, in the context of a protracted military conflict, such as the situation in Donbas, age-related development challenges are imposed on an extreme context of constant threat, uncertainty, traumatic stress, and socio-economic deprivation. This creates a socio-psychological phenomenon that requires in-depth study. Purpose. Тo study the features of motivation to achieve success and its relationship with meaningful life orientations among students of Donbass living in the zone of military conflict. Materials and methods.Theoretical analysis of domestic and foreign scientific papers; empirical methods (survey, testing): The methodology «Motivation of students to achieve success in higher education» by S.A. Pakulina, «The methodology of personality diagnosis for motivation to success by T. Ehlers», «The methodology of personality diagnosis for motivation to avoid failures by T. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Ai-based approaches to the educational process organization for future teachers in a modern university
abstract: Background. In the article, the authors present one of the key tasks of a modern university: the AI-based organization of the educational process of future specialists. In the course of the theoretical analysis, the authors substantiate the relevance of using AI tools in higher education, where particular attention is paid to the integration of traditional and AI-based forms of learning. The article provides evidence of an integrated approach to the implementation of AI tools in the educational process in a modern university, specifically in training students in the academic programme 44.04.01 “Pedagogical Education.” At the same time, due attention is paid to the risks associated with the implementation of AI tools in the educational process of future teachers. Purpose –to theoretically substantiate that the implementation of AI tools in the educational process of future teachers in a modern university is effective. Materials and methods.The empirical basis of the article consists of studies by domestic and foreign authors on the organization of the educational process for future specialists using AI tools. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Pedagogical conditions for the professional development of rehabilitation facility staff
abstract: Background.Professional development of rehabilitation facility staff unfolds in a setting marked by interdisciplinarity, clinical uncertainty, and the need for coordinated teamwork. Conventional continuing education formats often fail to reflect the specificity of rehabilitation care: long-term patient engagement, integration of medical and educational technologies, and the centrality of communication and clinical-pedagogical reasoning. This creates a practical and research problem of identifying pedagogical conditions that ensure sustainable competence growth and reduce risks of professional maladaptation. Purpose.To identify and substantiate a set of pedagogical conditions that support the professional development of rehabilitation facility staff within competence-based and activity-oriented approaches. Materials and methods.The study draws on an analysis of Russian and international literature on adult professional learning, lifelong education, and interprofessional collaboration in clinical contexts, as well as on the review of local regulations and training practices in rehabilitation organizations. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: The relationship between loneliness and aggressiveness in adolescents
abstract: Background.Adolescence is a critical period of personal development in which the experience of loneliness and aggressive behavior represent interrelated psychological phenomena that threaten social adaptation. Despite the relevance of the problem, the mechanisms underlying the relationship between various forms of loneliness and specific types of aggressiveness in 13–14-year-old adolescents remain insufficiently studied. Purpose– to identify the nature and significance of the relationship between the experience of loneliness and various forms of aggressiveness in adolescents, and to establish gender differences in the manifestation of these phenomena. Materials and methods.An empirical study was conducted on a sample of 106 seventh-grade students (52 boys, 54 girls) from secondary schools in Vladivostok, aged 13–14 years. A battery of psychodiagnostic instruments was used: the UCLA Loneliness Scale (adapted by A.N. Kashirsky), the Emotions Test (Bass–Darkey modification by G.V. Rezapkina), the Cook–Medley Hostility Scale (adapted by Yu.A. Mendzheritskaya), and Rogova’s Loneliness Questionnaire. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Trends in the development of digital competence among students at a teacher-training university: an analysis based on the DigCompEdu model
abstract: Background.In the context of digital transformation in education, the development of digital competencies among prospective teachers has become a key requirement of professional standards. Particular importance is attached to the readiness of foreign language teachers to independently develop digital educational resources using artificial intelligence tools. Purpose.To analyse the dynamics of digital competency development among students pursuing pedagogical degrees during their university education and to evaluate the effectiveness of the course “Workshop on Developing an Electronic Educational and Methodological Complex” (EEMC) as a means of fostering professionally relevant digital skills. Materials and methods.The study involved 68 students enrolled in the “Pedagogical Education” programme (“Foreign Languages”), distributed across years of study. The level of digital competence was assessed using an adapted questionnaire based on the international DigCompEdu framework, comprising 25 competencies, 14 of which were identified as target competencies. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Optimization of mental states in students with visual impairments during online learning through linguo-didactic tools and artificial intelligence
abstract: Background.Distance learning in an inclusive setting imposes heightened demands on the psychological resources of students, particularly those with visual impairments. Prevailing pedagogical methodologies often fail to account for the specifics of their sensory deprivation and the associated fluctuations in mental states, which can adversely affect learning motivation and overall success in foreign language acquisition. Purpose.The aim of the present study was the experimental verification of a complex for optimizing the mental states of students with visual impairments during online learning through linguo-didactic means and artificial intelligence. Materials and methods.The study was conducted at the MySchool online foreign language school (English and German) in an inclusive format. The experiment involved 20 students with visual impairments (10 with congenital blindness, 10 with acquired blindness, aged 18–20). Validated questionnaires were employed: the "Well-Being – Activity – Mood" (SAN) inventory, the Kurgansky-Nemchin technique (assessing mental activation, interest, emotional tone, comfort, and tension), the Perceived Stress Scale (PSS) measuring global stress, distress,

journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Theoretical foundations of the author’s technique of existential-resource therapy
abstract: Background.This article focuses on the theoretical basis of the author's methodology of existential-resource therapy (ERT), which integrates the principles of existential psychology, attachment theory, and a systemic approach. Thepurposeof the study is to analyze the theoretical foundations of the method, demonstrate the effectiveness of ERT in overcoming emotional deficits, restoring contact with the resource core of the personality, and developing the skill of conscious choice for use in psychocorrectional work with students, teachers, and others. Materials and methods.The main method is theoretical analysis to substantiate the author's methodology. The methodology is based on the concept of existential psychology by V. Frankl, the theory of attachment by J. Bowlby and the concept of the inner child by D. Whitfield, resource-oriented approaches: positive psychology by M. Seligman, the concept of self-actualization by A. Maslow, and the systemic approach: the ideas of B. Hellinger and the neurobiological aspect of B. van der Kolk. title: The relationship between academic motivation and psychological well-being of high school students
abstract: Background.The work was carried out as part of the state assignment for science at Surgut State Pedagogical University for 2024-2026 on the topic "Creating a Psychologically Safe Environment in Educational Organizations of the Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug-Yugra." The relevance of the study is due to the growing problem of declining academic motivation among high school students. The specific nature of academic and professional activities in grades 10-11, characterized by increased demands for independence and responsibility, often leads to emotional stress. Despite the significance of this issue, there is a lack of comprehensive research in the scientific literature on the relationship between academic motivation and the psychological well-being of high school students. This makes it difficult to develop effective and scientifically grounded strategies for providing psychological support to students. Purpose -to study theoretically and empirically the relationship between motivation and psychological well-being of high school students. title: Final assessment and evaluation of language proficiency among students at gymnasiums in St. Petersburg in the late 19th and early 20th centuries
abstract: Background.The interest in the history of language gymnasium education is not accidental. Gymnasiums have always been centers of high-quality language education, so now, by introducing innovations, it is necessary to maintain continuity with the valuable pedagogical heritage of the past. The development of language education at the turn of the 19th and 20th centuries followed the general trend of transformations that encompassed the entire system of gymnasium education in Russia. These changes were characterized by the liberalization of the educational process, the humanization of relationships between its subjects. In this new paradigm, language becomes a tool for personal development. In the context of these changes, the organization of the entire language educational process in gymnasiums was changing. In this regard, it is of interest to study the essence of the final control and assessment of learners' language knowledge in the history of gymnasium education. The study is based on a corpus of materials related to St. Petersburg gymnasiums of the late 19th and early 20th centuries. title: Particularities of emotional ill-being and self-regulation among representatives of socionomic and signonomic professions
abstract: Background.An excessive flow of information, the rapid variability of news related to economic conditions combined with negative expectations about the future, the development of artificial intelligence, and the growth of professional workloads—all these factors contribute to the emergence of chronic emotional tension, increased excitability, and dysthymia. In the modern world, the working activity sphere serves as the main space for personal realization, while emotional ill-being acts as an indicator of disrupted self-regulation mechanisms and reduced professional stability. Objectiveis to study emotional ill-being and self-regulation among representatives of signonomic and socionomic professions. Materials and methods. A theoretical analysis of the literature devoted to the problem of emotional ill-being and self-regulation was conducted. Empirical methods included: the “Volitional Self-Regulation Questionnaire” (A.V. Zverkov and E.V. Eidman); the “Cognitive Emotion Regulation Questionnaire” (N. Garnefski, V. Kraaij; adapted by O.L. journal_name: Russian Journal of Education and Psychology
title: Confessional identity in the context of digital syncretism: pedagogical strategies for critical thinking
abstract: Background. The article addresses the challenge of fostering and sustaining students’ confessional identity under digital syncretism, where cross-border information flows intensify competing interpretations of faith and weaken practical distinctions between authoritative and non-authoritative sources. The study aims to identify the main vectors that blur confessional identity in digital environments and to design a pedagogically valid toolkit for critical navigation supporting critical religious thinking. The methodology combines a systematic content analysis of digital religious materials (450 posts, 180 videos, 120 dialogue threads), a pedagogical experiment in a theological education setting (87 students divided into control and experimental groups), and semi-structured interviews followed by qualitative open coding. The findings reveal three stable vectors of identity erosion: algorithmic «echo chambers», relativization of truth criteria, and genre/context mixing in digital religious content, which together undermine source verification and increase susceptibility to syncretic narratives. title: Business board game for the formation of foreign language professional interaction ability
abstract: Background.Current trends in scientific and technological progress are leading to the unification of the educational landscape. Changing priorities in the fields of upbringing and education are leading to updates in the structure and content of core professional educational programs, as well as changes in mandatory requirements for the educational space. Improving the structure of programs and the conditions for their implementation necessitates the development and application of various modern teaching methods in the educational process. Purpose.Development of methodological support for the formation of the ability for professional interaction in a foreign language among students of a specialist program using a business board game of the economic sphere. Materials and methods.Methods of theoretical analysis of scientific and educational literature, content-analysis and comparative analysis. Results.A methodological approach to developing professional interaction skills in a foreign language is proposed for students in the Faculty of Economics and Management's specialty program using a business board game of the economic sphere. title: Comparative analysis of the viability of youth involved and not involved in socially significant activities
abstract: Background.In the context of increasing uncertainty and dynamic social changes, research on vitality – as an integral human ability to adapt to stressful factors, maintain psychological well–being and achieve success - is becoming extremely relevant. Currently, the study of the viability of young people involved in socially significant activities of public associations is of particular scientific interest. Such associations are the most important resource for the adaptation and self-realization of the younger generation, and their proactive activities create the basis for the formation of a talent pool of future leaders of the country. However, despite their undoubted importance and relevance, there are no comprehensive studies to determine the role of public associations in the development of youth vitality, which determines the scientific novelty, theoretical and practical significance of this study. title: The role of meaning-making activity in shaping an individual’s social position
abstract: Background.The polycentric nature of modern reality places new demands on individuals, such as being flexible, socially active, and proficient in their respective fields. The meaning-making activity of an individual is shaped within the context of their collective and individual value systems, serving as a crucial component of their overall personality. In today's highly uncertain environment, adaptability and resilience, which are based on personal meanings and values, take on significant importance. Understanding the functioning of meaning-making activity allows individuals to develop the qualities necessary for comprehending and shaping their social positions. Purpose.Research on semantic activity as a foundation for the formation of a social position in the educational environment. Materials and methods. The main research method is scientific and theoretical analysis. The article is based on a complex of sources: fundamental works, scientific publications, materials of conferences and seminars, which allows us to study the phenomenon of meaning-making activity and analyze the factors that shape an individual's social position during the learning process. title: Socio-psychological features of the observer related to the accuracy of perception of the relationship in a couple based on non-verbal signs
abstract: Background.The research is aimed at studying the observer's characteristics related to the accuracy of perception of the relationship in a couple using non-verbal communication based on video materials. The study examined the pair relationship between a man and a woman who are in a friendly and loving relationship, as well as in a dating situation. Based on the observed non-verbal signs, the respondents (N = 70, age M = 23, σ ± 4) justified their conclusions. Purpose.The study of the observer's characteristics related to the accuracy of perception of the relationship in a couple (love or friendship, dating relationship) with the opposite sex through non-verbal communication. Materials and methods.The work used the author's development of stimulating video material to determine the ability of people to distinguish romantic relationships from friendly ones using non-verbal signals (9 video clips); Emotional Empathic Tendency Scale, EETS to A. Mehrabian, N. Epstein; scales (tasks) of V.A.
